text: D. B. Knudson/C. L. Council Clc
In reference to your memo on the above-mentioned subject dated September 13, 1994,
please be advised that Quality Assurance and Technical Services will maintain their
current Retention Schedules through 1993. However, beginning with the 1994 calendar
year, steps are being taken to merge these two Retention Schedules into the MTS
(Engineering) Schedule. Once all of our records in the Versatile system have been
disposed/transferred to storage and have met total storage retention time, we can then take
the necessary steps to void these two Retention Schedules.
